name: 砚章公文写作
description: Draft, revise, review, research, store, and export Chinese official documents.
description_zh: 完成公文拟题、成文、改写、审校、资料检索、版本管理与 Word 导出。
description_en: Draft, revise, review, research, store, and export Chinese official documents.
examples_zh: 围绕政绩观生成十个排比式标题，并说明推荐理由
检索权威文章来源，按三段式方法起草一篇讲话稿
审校这篇材料中的事实、占位符和表达问题
保存当前文稿并导出带 Word 域的模板
examples_en: Generate ten parallel-style titles about performance evaluation and rank them
Research official articles and draft a three-part speech
Review this document for factual support, placeholders, and style issues
Save the current draft and export a Word field template
